digest.component_or_area: review-bot event store and persistent clone management
propositions: Two untracked event JSON files exist in the persistent review-bot clone with no corresponding commits in origin/tickets, requiring classification as unique recoverable data or disposable residue.
The first stranded TICKET_DIGEST file is an unsigned derived cache superseded by later committed digests for the same ticket and can be safely discarded.
The second stranded CLAIM_ENRICH file represents an expired lease with a superseded later claim and completed DONE state, making it expired queue residue eligible for disposal.

After authorized deletion of both files conditioned on hash matching and git status exactness, the persistent clone must verify clean state with HEAD equalling refs/remotes/origin/tickets and no untracked files.
